text:
Maya: Heads up — API gateway p95 latency jumped to ~3.6s and errors creeping to ~5% across regions, started ~00:42 UTC. Im paging oncall.
incident-bot: New incident INC-2026-082 created (severity=P1) for api-latency-high. Owner: @kyle.
Kyle: Im looking at the runtime pools now. gpu-pool-2 has sustained high in-flight count and executor threads hitting configured max_in_flight=128.
Jess: Queue depth for gpu-pool-2 is growing, KV-cache miss rate increased. A few clients are sending long-token streams that chew slots.
Liam: Support has 4 reports of timeouts in last 20m; two are high-traffic batch customers.
Maya: Quick mitigation draft: 1) apply soft per-key throttles 2) reduce max_in_flight on gpu-pool-2 from 128 -> 32 and bounce workers 3) shed very long requests (>800 tokens) with 429+Retry-After 30s 4) temporarily turn off realtime-suggestions on public keys. Any other risks?
Tom: Fine with those. Prefer soft throttles first to avoid 5xx spikes. Need to notify SLA customers before aggressive shedding.
Kyle: Applying soft throttles via adminctl now. Command: adminctl limits set --scope=global --mode=soft --rps=18
deploy-bot: soft-limits change accepted; rolling to edge caches (canary 5%).
Jess: Patching runtime config on nodes in gpu-pool-2: editing /etc/redwood/runtime.yaml -> max_in_flight: 32. Will restart workers one AZ at a time.
Jess: Commands:
- kubectl rollout restart daemonset/redwood-runtime -n prod --selector=pool=gpu-pool-2
- ./scripts/drain_pool.sh gpu-pool-2 --grace=20
Maya: Adding shedding rule to ingress for large bodies and long-sequence heuristic. Nginx snippet:
```
location /v1/generate {
  if ($content_length > 8192) {
    add_header Retry-After 30;
    return 429;
  }
}
```
Liam: Sending proactive customer note to affected accounts and tagging SLA owners. For Cust-A and Cust-B (paid) I propose we whitelist/raise soft limits while throttling batch Cust-Z.
Kyle: Quota override for SLA keys applied: adminctl quota override --key=cust-a-prod --rps=200 --duration=1h
Tom: Feature flag toggle: disabling realtime-suggestions for public keys only via flags-service. Command: curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flags/toggle -d '{"feature":"realtime-suggestions","state":"off","scope":"public"}'
deploy-bot: feature change deployed to flags-service.
Jess: Also lowering generation timeout for best-effort tier from 45s -> 20s (generation_timeout_ms:20000) to free slots. Pushed config and restarted policy agent.
Jess: Observability: Maya, please add a drilldown for 429s and throttled calls by API key so we can see which keys are being shed.
Maya: Dashboard updated. Early signals: 3 keys show most 429s (cust-z-batch, test-internal-42, partner-x). Cust-Z is a nightly batch job spiking long sequences.
Liam: Temporarily pausing Cust-Z job and asking partner to backoff. Support sent instruction and a temporary hold request.
Support-Bot: Cust-Z job paused (ticket #TKT-2102).
Kyle: After soft limits + max_in_flight reduction + shedding + timeout reductions: p95 latency from ~3.6s -> ~1.0s over 8 minutes. Error rate down 5% -> 0.5%. Queue depth trending down.
Maya: Confirming no widespread 5xx spike. Most customers seeing improved success; a few SLA keys had brief increased latency but no errors due to overrides.
Tom: Good work. Next: keep mitigations in place for 30m, run a targeted config rollback plan to restore defaults gradually if stable.
Kyle: Ill hand off monitoring to @Nora in 12m when I go offline. Nora, please keep an eye and be ready to re-enable shedding if queue climbs.
Nora: Ack — will monitor dashboards and watch for >10% increase in queue depth or >1% error rate.
Maya: Filing RCA ticket for eng-runtime to investigate why autoshed/autoscaling didnt trigger sooner: TKT-5799 (root cause: investigation).
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-082 status -> mitigated. Owner: Nora. Monitoring period 45m.
Liam: Drafted interim customer update and incident summary; will append final timeline after RCA.
Jess: Follow-ups: 1) consider adaptive per-key max_in_flight, 2) add automatic shedding policy for long sequences, 3) improve alerting thresholds on active-inflight vs capacity.
Kyle: Nice quick runbook execution, folks. :thumbsup:
